findings.problem: The example uses words not met before this card: pan, en, mesa. In the frequency phase it may use at most two words not met yet.

back.es: there is / there are (impersonal form of haber)
back.example: There is bread on the table.

note: The strip puts hay in the él slot as the format requires, but the auxiliary él form is ha (él ha comido), so it may be worth showing that somewhere so learners don't say "él hay".
